fix_instructions: To make the scenario solvable only via multi-agent communication, tighten the content checks so they do not pass on generic or vague descriptions. For example, C1 and C2 must require the exact time window 'Friday 18:00-Monday 08:00' from PF1, and C4/C8 must require the specific '08:00 and 20:00 with food' schedule from PF3. Currently, the model can satisfy the ''spirit' of the decision without accessing the precise values required by the decisive facts.
